edits.before: The Northern Neck doesn't have that problem. It doesn't have a bridge at all.
edits.after: The Northern Neck doesn't have that problem. If you take 301 through Newburg, there's the Harry W. Nice Bridge — a quick Potomac crossing with no backup — and if you come straight down 95 and Route 3, there's no bridge at all. Either way, you're never watching a two-lane toll span stretch to the horizon at 5 p.m. on a Friday.
edits.note: Factual correction: the US-301 route DOES cross the Potomac on the Harry W. Nice Memorial Bridge (Newburg, MD → Dahlgren, VA). Rewrote to be route-dependent — 301 users get the Nice Bridge (quick, no backup); I-95/Route-3 users have no bridge at all. Either path contrasts against the Bay Bridge chokepoint. Accurate and in voice.
